observations.title: Overworld biodiversity
observations.player_action: Explore Spawn Overworld biomes, animals and ambient features.
observations.outcome: Mod-wide exploration activities beyond item collection.

observations.title: Datapack-configurable animal spawn
observations.player_action: Use native Spawn config/datapack integrations to specify animal variants, spawns and selected recipe systems.
observations.outcome: Data-first extensibility instead of overriding AI everywhere.
observations.review_note: Check 4.0.7 resource paths before authoring real datapack changes.

observations.title: Spawn recipe discovery via JEI
observations.player_action: Use JEI to discover special Spawn recipes where registered.
observations.outcome: Guide can teach the native recipe interface.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Найди специальный рецепт Spawn в JEI.

observations.title: Jade information support
observations.player_action: Jade integration supplies information for some specialized Spawn interactions such as stickbugs and octopus-locked chests.

observations.title: Angler fish utility lead
observations.player_action: The installed English localization describes feeding shiny items to an Angler Fish for Night Vision; it can be carried in a bucket.
observations.review_note: LOCALIZATION_ONLY: neither target-item tag nor AI event is proven; verify 4.0.7 code before offering concrete instructions.

observations.title: Optional Farmer's Delight food additions
observations.player_action: Spawn project advertises new foods using animal drops when Farmer's Delight is installed.
observations.outcome: Only relevant when optional integration is present.
observations.review_note: Do not generate quests for absent optional integrations.
